title: Impact
html:
• Saṁyutta Nikāya 1.22 Linked Discourses 1.22
  • 3. Sattivagga 3. A Sword

Phusatisutta Impact

“Nāphusantaṁ phusati ca, “It doesn’t impact one who doesn’t impact others. phusantañca tato phuse; It impacts one because they impact others. Tasmā phusantaṁ phusati, That’s why it impacts one who impacts, appaduṭṭhapadosinan”ti. who wrongs one who’s done no wrong.”

“Yo appaduṭṭhassa narassa dussati, “Whoever wrongs a man who has done no wrong, Suddhassa posassa anaṅgaṇassa; a pure man who has not a blemish, Tameva bālaṁ pacceti pāpaṁ, the evil backfires on the fool, Sukhumo rajo paṭivātaṁva khitto”ti. like fine dust thrown upwind.”
